vb_textbox.text: I really don't think it matters which gnome you click. For 40 or so turns, I only clicked certain colors. The next 40 turns I only clicked the gnome with a tall hat. Then 40 turns I only clicked the gnome on the left. Then only the gnome on the right. Then random clicks. To me, I always had the same spread of mushrooms no matter what my strategy was.
